name: ComfyUI v0.24.0 core nodes (DualModelGuider, CFGOverride, Ideogram4Scheduler)
notes: Released 2026-06-03. DualModelGuider allows separate cond/uncond model passes. CFGOverride pins CFG over a step range. Ideogram4Scheduler for Ideogram 4 models. Tier 1 node-pack update — applies to all builders once ComfyUI is updated to v0.24.

name: ComfyUI-JiT-Flux2 — Just-in-Time spatial acceleration (xmarre)
notes: Training-free up-to-7x speedup for Flux.2 inference via sparse anchor-token evaluation (arXiv:2603.10744). No model change. Drop-in node wrapper for all build_klein_* and Flux.2 txt2img/img2img builders. Direct RTX 5060 Ti benefit.

name: ComfyUI-PuLID-Flux2 v0.6.2 + pulid_flux2_klein_v1/v2 weights
notes: Updated 2026-03-21. Native Klein 4B/9B weights (pulid_flux2_klein_v1.safetensors / v2). Improved face recognition, reduced artifacts. TeaCache/WaveSpeed compatible. HF weights: https://huggingface.co/Fayens/Pulid-Flux2.

name: IC-Light V2 (Flux-based, 16ch VAE)
notes: Flux-based, significant quality jump over SD1.5 V1. NON-COMMERCIAL license only — license regression from V1 (commercial-ok). Only foreground-conditional model released; background + combined pending. fal.ai API node: https://github.com/a-und-b/ComfyUI_IC-Light-v2_fal.

name: FLUX.1-dev-ControlNet-Union-Pro-2.0 (Shakker-Labs)
notes: 3.98 GB (down from 6.15 GB v1). Canny/Depth/Soft-Edge/Pose/Grayscale unified. Trained 20M images / 300K steps. Flux.1-dev compatible. Drop-in upgrade if already using Union Pro v1.

name: HyperSwap 1a/1b/1c ONNX (facefusion/models-3.3.0)
notes: Three ONNX variants: 1a=speed, 1b=balanced, 1c=quality. 2x resolution vs inswapper_128 (256px crop vs 128px). Already supported in ComfyUI-ReActor May 2026. Copy to models/hyperswap/.

name: ComfyUI-ReActor May 2026 release
notes: Updated 2026-05-12. New nodes: Restore Face Advanced (with Face Restore Filter), ReActorMaskHelper, Unload ReActor Models. GPEN 1024/2048 restoration backends. HyperSwap 256 support. Affects build_faceswap, build_faceswap_mtb, build_face_restore, build_save_face_model.

name: ComfyUI-Flux-FaceIR + IConFace LoRA (cosmicrealm)
notes: Published May 2026. FLUX.2-Klein-4B-backed blind + reference-guided face restoration (arXiv 2605.02814). Supports up to 3 reference faces. Klein 4B fp8 ~8-10 GB VRAM; fits 16 GB. Low community vetting. Relevant to build_klein_face_detail as unified upgrade.

name: FaceFusion 3.3.0 model bundle
notes: Complete bundle: HyperSwap 1a/1b/1c + updated face detectors, enhancers, processors. Refresh build_faceswap_model to reference this repo.

name: SAM 3.1 (facebook/sam3.1)
notes: Released 2026-03-27. Object Multiplex: shared-memory multi-object tracking, ~7x faster at 128 objects, no accuracy loss. Gated HF download — request access first. Drop-in checkpoint swap for all three SAM3 builders.

name: SAM 3.1 (facebook/sam3.1)
notes: Same checkpoint as build_sam3_segment entry. Drop-in for build_sam3_mask.

name: SAM 3.1 (facebook/sam3.1)
notes: Same checkpoint as build_sam3_segment entry. Drop-in for build_sam3_extract.

name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2-4B
notes: Released 2026-01-29. 4B flow-matching DiT, O-Voxel sparse latents, 512x3 in ~3s at 16 GB VRAM (1024x3 needs 40 GB — skip). MIT license. Full PBR output. ComfyUI wrapper: github.com/visualbruno/ComfyUI-Trellis2. GGUF fork also available.

name: Pixal3D (TencentARC, SIGGRAPH 2026)
notes: arXiv 2605.10922, published May 2026. Pixel-aligned image-to-3D via back-projection conditioning. MIT license. TRELLIS.2 backbone variant. ComfyUI: github.com/Saganaki22/Pixal3D-ComfyUI.

name: SurGe: Improved Surface Geometry in Point Maps
notes: arXiv 2605.31577, weights released 2026-06-01 (CC BY-NC 4.0). Gradient matching loss + NAD decoder on MoGe-class backbone. Best avg rank on 8 zero-shot geometry benchmarks. DINOv2 encoder, VRAM ~8-12 GB.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 — modular 4-node redesign (BREAKING CHANGE)
notes: BREAKING: monolithic node replaced by 4-node pipeline (DIT loader, VAE loader, upscaler core, torch.compile settings). GGUF Q4_K_M drops 7B model from 24 GB to 8 GB VRAM. Latest tag v2.5.23. Build workflows must be rebuilt before deploying.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 (same node pack, also covers build_seedv2r)
notes: Same as build_seedvr2_video_upscale entry. BREAKING node architecture change.

name: FlashVSR v1.1 (CVPR 2026)
notes: CVPR 2026. One-step VSR with Locality-Constrained Sparse Attention. ~17 FPS at 768x1408, peak 11.1 GB VRAM. Best for real-footage content (SeedVR2 wins on AI-generated clips). ComfyUI: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR, naxci1/ComfyUI-FlashVSR_Stable, lihaoyun6/ComfyUI-FlashVSR_Ultra_Fast. Ensure LCSA is not stripped.

name: LTX-2.3 (22B, redesigned VAE, native 9:16)
notes: Released 2026-03-06. Supersedes LTX-Video 0.9.x and LTX-2. 22B, gated attention text connector, redesigned VAE. GGUF Q4_K_M (unsloth/LTX-2.3-GGUF) ~12 GB VRAM. Day-0 ComfyUI support. NVFP4 variant 'coming soon' for Blackwell.

name: LTX-2 (19B, audio+video generation)
notes: Released 2026-01-06. First production audio+video combined model. Supersedes LTX-Video 0.9.x. GGUF fits ~12 GB. Day-0 ComfyUI support. LTX-2.3 is the preferred upgrade if VRAM allows.

name: Kijai/WanVideo_comfy_nvfp4 — NVFP4 quantisation for Blackwell
notes: Created 2026-05-28 (~2x speedup vs FP8 on RTX 50-series). Requires PyTorch cu130. fp8_scaled variant also updated 2026-06-01. Additive — same model, new quantisation file.

name: Ideogram 4.0 nf4 (9.3B NextDiT, Qwen3-VL text encoder)
notes: Released 2026-06-03. Best open text-rendering and prompt-adherence. nf4 quant confirmed 16 GB VRAM. Non-commercial open weights. New Ideogram4Scheduler required — suggest new build_ideogram4_txt2img builder. Comfy-Org official wrap: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4.

name: Qwen-Image-2.0 (7B unified gen+edit)
notes: Released 2026-02-10. 7B (down from ~20B), #1 AI Arena txt2img + editing, native 2K, improved text rendering. Architecture + tokenizer changes require workflow updates, not just checkpoint swap.

name: FireRed-Image-Edit 1.1
notes: v1.1 released 2026-03-09. Open-source SOTA instruction editing, strong identity/character consistency, multi-image conditioning, GGUF quants. HF: https://huggingface.co/FireRedTeam/FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0-ComfyUI. New builder method needed (build_firered_edit).

name: VIBE: Visual Instruction Based Editor (Qwen3-VL-2B + Sana1.5-1.6B)
notes: arXiv 2601.02242, Jan 2026. ~4-6 GB VRAM, fast inference, strong source consistency for object removal / background edits / attribute adjustment. ComfyUI PR node: https://github.com/ComfyNodePRs/PR-ComfyUI-VIBE-11e7b9c7. Suggest build_vibe_edit or wire into build_magic_eraser.

name: ComfyUI-LBM (Latent Bridge Matching relighting)
notes: Outperforms IC-Light V1: subject-aware relighting, no extraneous shadow injection, better detail preservation. Runs on standard Flux infrastructure. Fits 16 GB. Could replace IC-Light V1 path in build_iclight.

name: ComfyUI-Flux2Klein-Conditioning-Toolkit (xmarre)
notes: Active as of late May/early June 2026. Region-aware text enhancement, sectioned prompt encoding, corrected reference-latent mixing with multi-reference support for Flux.2 Klein. Additive for all build_klein_* builders.

name: ComfyUI-Flux.2-Untwisting-RoPE (xmarre)
notes: Frequency-aware RoPE reference-attention control for Flux.2 in ComfyUI. Tunes reference influence from style to structural copying. Drop-in conditioning hook for build_style_transfer on Flux.2/Klein.

name: ComfyUI-Flux2Klein-Enhancer v3 (capitan01R)
notes: Updated 2026-01-26. Commit-based token-matching reduces feature mush on edits. Automatic active-region detection from attention mask.

name: Wan 2.7 (T2V/I2V/image editing/video editing)
notes: Released ~2026-04-22. New video editing mode added alongside T2V/I2V. Same VRAM profile as Wan 2.2 14B with GGUF/FP8. Verify HF org for confirmed weights — Alibaba Cloud announcement but direct HF link TBC.

name: Wan2.2-Animate-14B
notes: Released 2025-09-19, natively in ComfyUI. Driving-video + character image for animation or character-replacement. If build_wan_animate_video is not yet pointing to this checkpoint, update immediately.

name: Wan2.2-S2V-14B — audio/sound-to-video (new capability category)
notes: Released 2025-08-26, natively in ComfyUI. Static image + audio -> synchronised talking/performing video. Lip-sync, singing, digital humans. FP8 variant fits 16 GB. Warrants new build_wan_s2v builder method.

name: HunyuanVideo-1.5 (8.3B lightweight)
notes: Released 2025-11-21. 8.3B vs 13B original. FP8 fits ~14-16 GB (borderline — test offload on RTX 5060 Ti). 75-second videos, distilled I2V reduces time 75%. FP8 GEMM support added Dec 2025.

name: FramePack T2V/I2V/FLF2V multi-mode update (HunyuanVideo backbone)
notes: As of 2026-05-13 an implementation adds T2V, I2V, and FLF2V modes. FramePack-F1 (anti-drift) already shipped May 2025. VRAM minimum 6 GB per project page. Update build_framepack_video to use multi-mode support.

name: OSDFace (CVPR 2025) — one-step diffusion face restoration
notes: CVPR 2025 weights public. ~0.1s per 512x512 face. VRE + VQ dictionary + face identity loss, outperforms CodeFormer on perceptual metrics. No dedicated ComfyUI node — needs facerestore_cf wrapper or custom integration.

name: facerestore_advanced (flickleafy)
notes: Drop-in upgrade of facerestore_cf with multi-metric quality assessment (SSIM, artifact detection, color bleed, geometric distortion), model fallback, intelligent caching. Uses existing CodeFormer/GFPGAN weights.

name: DreamID — High-Fidelity Diffusion Face Swap (arXiv 2504.14509)
notes: SD Turbo backbone, highest identity-similarity among diffusion-based swappers. Public weights exist but no ComfyUI node found. Requires custom integration. VRAM SD Turbo ~fits 16 GB.

name: DreamID-V-Wan-1.3B-Faster (ByteDance, video face swap)
notes: Video face swapping via Wan-1.3B diffusion transformer. Faster variant released 2026-01-12. ComfyUI JR fork targets 16 GB specifically (github.com/Goldlionren/ComfyUI_JR_DreamID-V). Risk HIGH: early community vetting; original targets 4090/5090.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration Challenge top entries
notes: arXiv 2604.10532, April 2026 NTIRE workshop. Top team models not yet publicly released. Uses AdaFace identity checker. Track for weight releases; relevant to build_photo_restore and build_face_restore.

name: Hunyuan3D-2.1 PBR (full PBR textures)
notes: Released June 2025. Adds real PBR (diffuse/metallic/roughness/normal maps). Shape gen fits 16 GB; texture Paint stage needs ~20 GB — test fp8 offload on RTX 5060 Ti. ComfyUI: kijai/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3DWrapper and Yuan-ManX/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3D-2.1.

name: HunyuanWorld-Mirror (ICML 2026) — unified depth+normal+3DGS
notes: ICML 2026 poster; weights released Oct 2025. Feed-forward universal 3D reconstruction: point clouds, multi-view depth, camera params, surface normals, 3DGS from single/multi-view images. VRAM unconfirmed — test before wiring.

name: Lotus-2 (FLUX-backbone depth+normal estimator)
notes: arXiv 2512.01030. FLUX backbone, new SOTA zero-shot on NYUv2/KITTI/ETH3D. Weights stabilised early 2026. FLUX backbone borderline at 16 GB — VRAM test needed before committing to build_depth_map_v3.

name: Stable Diffusion 4 Base + Ultra
notes: SD4 Base released April 2026, Ultra late April 2026. New DiT, native 4096x4096. Ultra VRAM at 16 GB unconfirmed — likely needs 24 GB+; Base may work quantised. ControlNet variants pending. Revisit July 2026.

name: PI-Light: Physics-Inspired Diffusion Relighting (ICLR 2026)
notes: arXiv 2601.22135, ICLR 2026. Physics-guided neural rendering, batch-aware attention. GitHub: https://github.com/ZhexinLiang/PI-Light. No ComfyUI node yet. Monitor for integration.

name: ComfyUI-DiffAid-Patches (xmarre)
notes: Flux.2 sparse block modulation and SDXL cross-attention variant for surgical text-conditioning modification at inference. Early/experimental, low community vetting.

name: Wan 3.0 (60B, native 1080p) — unconfirmed weights
notes: Referenced in blog sources as 'early 2026' at 60B params / native 1080p. HuggingFace weights under Wan-AI not confirmed. 60B would require aggressive quantisation for 16 GB — probably infeasible without BlockSwap. Monitor.

name: WaveSpeed LTX-2 Video Upscaler Pro
notes: LTX-2 19B backbone, 4K upscaling with strong temporal consistency. API-first — local weights availability unconfirmed. Monitor for weight release.

name: SwapAnyHead — Controllable Video Head Swapping (arXiv 2506.16852)
notes: 3DMM-driven expression retargeting, shape-agnostic masking. Diffusion-based, one-shot. Project: humanaigc.github.io/SwapAnyHead/. No weights or ComfyUI node confirmed yet.

name: AlphaFace — Pose-Robust Real-Time Face Swap (arXiv 2601.16429)
notes: CLIP visual+text contrastive losses for extreme-pose robustness. Published Jan 2026. No public weights or ComfyUI node found. Research only.

name: LPNSR: Prior-Enhanced Diffusion SR (arXiv 2603.21045)
notes: LR-guided noise prediction for ResShift-style SR. No confirmed public weights or GitHub repo as of 2026-06-10. Watch for weight release.

name: GuideSR (ICCVW 2025)
notes: Dual-branch one-step LDM, +1.39 dB PSNR on real-world data. No ComfyUI wrapper. Weights unconfirmed. Lower priority than SeedVR2/FlashVSR.

name: Hunyuan3D 3.0 (announced Sep 2025, weights status unclear)
notes: Claims 3x modeling accuracy, 1536x3 geometry. Open-source weight status unconfirmed as of 2026-06-10. Monitor Tencent-Hunyuan GitHub org.

name: RoSE: Normal Estimation via Shading Sequence (arXiv 2602.09929)
notes: Feb 2026. Reformulates normal estimation as shading-sequence prediction via video diffusion model. SOTA on object benchmarks. High VRAM (video diffusion backbone). No confirmed public weights.

name: New Wan 2.1/2.2 community LoRAs (Muapi, June 3–8 2026)
notes: Multiple LoRAs published June 2–8 2026 by Muapi: dslr-photo-video-low-noise (Jun 8), thefoodmage-3d-artist-style (Jun 4), tfm-kash-realistic (Jun 4), cyberpunk2077-characters (May 24), asian-women-t2v (May 24), detailz-detail-enhancer (May 23). All Apache-2.0, target Wan 2.1/2.2 14B T2V.
